reviews.comment: Professor Do was a great professor! He cares about everyone doing well in his class and also responds quickly to emails. We had 3 tests and 3 papers for our entire grade. He is very lenient with grading and has kahoots ready for the class before the day of the exam. Overall a great professor, I would highly recommend taking any of his courses!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's an online course, so everything is easy to understand through lectures. As long as you get a good group for the last two projects, you will be ok. He responds quickly to emails and cares about everyone in the group doing an equal amount of work (there are surveys saying who did what at the end). Overall, a great professor and an easy class!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework
